purpose: Expanded SPICE/Horizons comparison using independent test-only lunar coordinates, altitudes, and dates.
coordinate_note: All coordinates below are arbitrary test inputs for software verification, not CLPS sites, mission data, or candidate locations.
limitations: All coordinates are software-test inputs, not mission or candidate locations.
Horizons uses DE441 and the independent SPICE setup uses DE440s with DE440 lunar orientation; small ephemeris differences are expected.
This matrix covers three sites and nine total times only; it is not a global accuracy or terrain-visibility validation.
Horizons output rows are rounded to six decimal places.
The Horizons third-case report marked the timestamps with an asterisk; the time stamps and angles are retained as returned, without interpreting the asterisk as a validation status.
